resources.string: A distraction-free, mindful home screen experience.
OFF by default. Your phone will continue ringing and receiving notifications normally. You can enable focus silencing anytime in Settings.
Keep only your chosen essential apps on your home screen during work or downtime to protect your focus.
No data ever leaves your device. We do not alter your system settings without your permission.
Quickly start with the Essentials profile (DND is off, ready to use).
Choose a custom name, select allowed apps, and pick a color right now.
FairMoment does not require system modifications. Do Not Disturb access is only needed if you explicitly choose to silence notifications during Moments.
A mindful approach to your smartphone.
Instead of a chaotic grid of 50+ apps vying for your attention, a Moment is an intentional home screen mode crafted for a specific part of your day—like Work, Focus, or Downtime.
Choose up to 4 essential apps to place front and center. All your other installed apps remain secure and accessible anytime in your full app drawer.
100% on-device and offline. We never push ads or force Do Not Disturb—your calls and messages arrive normally unless you choose to mute them.
Give this profile an identity that reflects your state of mind.
Tap the icon badge above to cycle symbols, or pick a quick suggestion below.
Pick 1 to 4 apps to feature on your home screen.
Please select at least 1 app to continue.
You can select up to 4 apps for this Moment.
Select a peaceful duotone gradient for this Moment.
Your first intentional home screen is configured.
You can seamlessly switch between Moments or create more anytime right from your home screen indicator.
